versions.changelog:
First version - not yet launched 

This skill is a decision-support and research-telemetry heuristic. It is not:





a clinically validated psychometric instrument



a regulated actuarial model



a financial prediction engine



a deterministic collapse detector



a diagnostic, defamatory, or legal instrument

Scores are structured estimates derived from available evidence. They require provenance, confidence bands, uncertainty notes, and longitudinal validation before being treated as empirically reliable. Outputs flag elevated correction, rupture, or repricing risk; they do not predict deterministic outcomes.
